title: Reading an Indian electricity bill and standby loads
summary: Household estimates in EcoTwin start from your billed kWh and the energy charge you type in. Standby (idle) loads exist, but their size must be measured or left as a low-confidence estimate.
content:
Telangana households typically receive bills from TSSPDCL (greater Hyderabad and surrounding circles) or TGNPDCL. EcoTwin does not store a DISCOM tariff schedule because slabs and fixed charges change and vary by circle.

Record for each month: billed kWh, energy charge in ₹/kWh if shown, and total amount in rupees. Mark the record as measured when it comes from the bill.

Idle electronics still draw some power. A plug-in meter is the honest way to quantify this. Without measurement, EcoTwin may offer a qualitative reminder only, not a precise rupee figure.

Grid greenhouse-gas intensity for India is published by the Central Electricity Authority in its CDM CO2 Baseline Database. EcoTwin will not apply a guessed kg CO2e/kWh. Paste the Combined Margin you read from CEA (or leave emissions uncalculated).
applicability_conditions: Has an electricity connection in India
implementation_steps: Photograph or keep the latest bill (do not upload bills to Eco-Scorer)
Enter kWh and rupee amount as a measured resource record
Type the energy charge ₹/kWh into Settings or Compare
Optional: measure standby devices with a plug meter before claiming savings
limitations: Fixed/demand charges are not always proportional to kWh saved
CEA factor was not copied because the database page was not publicly readable on 16 October 2026
